question: How will you write 2.6 years in years, months and days?
solution:
To convert 2.6 years into years, months, and days, follow these steps:

Step 1. Extract the whole number of years - 2.6 years means 2 full years.

Step 2. Convert the fractional part of the year into months - 0.6 years × 12 months/year = 7.2 months.

Step 3. Extract the whole number of months - 7.2 months means 7 full months.

Step 4. Convert the remaining fractional part of the month into day - 0.2 months × 30 days/month = 6 days (approximately, assuming 30 days in a month).

So, 2.6 years can be expressed as: 2 years, 7 months, and 6 days.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
